---
# yaml-language-server: $schema=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nf-core/modules/master/modules/environment-schema.json
channels:
  - conda-forge
  - bioconda
dependencies:
  - bioconda::aardvark=0.10.5

// Copyright (c) the nf-core community under an open-source MIT license.
// See https://github.com/nf-core/modules for full license, file patching instructions and upstream contributing.

process AARDVARK_COMPARE {
    tag "$meta.id"
    label 'process_low'

    conda "${moduleDir}/environment.yml"
    container "${ workflow.containerEngine in ['singularity', 'apptainer'] && !task.ext.singularity_pull_docker_container
?         'https://community-cr-prod.seqera.io/docker/registry/v2/blobs/sha256/b1/b1594cf6a0ecac04adf5a88a88f1da08e5a8eb0f21cd6d42024b1b343cce0870/data'
:         'community.wave.seqera.io/library/aardvark:0.10.5--50402c072fe171c0' }"

    input:
    tuple val(meta), path(query_vcf), path(query_vcf_tbi), path(truth_vcf), path(truth_vcf_tbi), path(regions_bed)
    tuple val(meta2), path(fasta)
    tuple val(meta3), path(stratification_tsv)
    tuple val(meta4), path(stratification_beds)

    output:
    tuple val(meta), path('*.summary.tsv')                    , emit: summary
    tuple val(meta), path('*.truth.vcf.gz')                   , emit: labelled_truth
    tuple val(meta), path('*.query.vcf.gz')                   , emit: labelled_query
    tuple val(meta), path('*.json')                           , emit: runinfo
    tuple val(meta), path('*.region_sequences.tsv.gz')        , emit: region_sequences
    tuple val(meta), path('*.region_summary.tsv.gz')          , emit: region_summary
    tuple val("${task.process}"), val('aardvark'), eval("aardvark compare --version 2>&1 | sed 's/aardvark-bio-compare //; s/-conda//'"), topic: versions, emit: versions_aardvark

    when:
    task.ext.when == null || task.ext.when

    script:
    def args = task.ext.args ?: ''
    def prefix = task.ext.prefix ?: "${meta.id}"
    def stratification = stratification_tsv && stratification_beds ? "--stratification ${stratification_tsv}" : ""
    """
    aardvark compare \\
        --threads $task.cpus \\
        --reference $fasta \\
        --truth-vcf $truth_vcf \\
        --query-vcf $query_vcf \\
        --regions $regions_bed \\
        $stratification \\
        --output-dir $prefix \\
        --output-debug $prefix \\
        $args

    for f in ${prefix}/*; do
        mv "\$f" "${prefix}.\${f##*/}"
    done

    """

    stub:
    def args = task.ext.args ?: ''
    def prefix = task.ext.prefix ?: "${meta.id}"
    """
    echo $args

    echo "" | gzip > ${prefix}.truth.vcf.gz
    echo "" | gzip > ${prefix}.query.vcf.gz
    echo "" | gzip > ${prefix}.region_sequences.tsv.gz
    echo "" | gzip > ${prefix}.region_summary.tsv.gz
    touch ${prefix}.summary.tsv
    touch ${prefix}.cli_settings.json
    """
}

---
name: "nf-core/aardvark/compare"
description: "A tool to evaluate variant calling performance by comparing a query\
  \ VCF against a truth VCF."
keywords:
- "variant calling"
- "benchmarking"
- "vcf"
- "comparison"
- "consensus"
tools:
- aardvark:
    description: "A benchmarking tool that constructs haplotype sequences and it enables\
      \ basepair-level\ncomparisons that work across all variant types. The program\
      \ evaluates genotypes using traditional,\nstrict exact-match scoring, while\
      \ also allowing for implicit partial credit when variant calls are an\ninexact\
      \ but close match.\n"
    homepage: "https://github.com/PacificBiosciences/aardvark"
    documentation: "https://github.com/PacificBiosciences/aardvark/blob/main/docs/methods.md#compare-command"
    tool_dev_url: "https://github.com/PacificBiosciences/aardvark"
    doi: "10.1101/2025.10.03.680257"
    licence:
    - "MIT"
    identifier: "biotools:aardvark"
input:
- - meta:
      type: "map"
      description: "Groovy Map containing sample information\ne.g. `[ id:'test' ]`\n"
  - query_vcf:
      type: "file"
      description: "Query VCF file to be benchmarked"
      pattern: "*.{vcf,vcf.gz}"
      ontologies:
      - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_3016"
  - query_vcf_tbi:
      type: "file"
      description: "Index for the query VCF file"
      pattern: "*.{vcf.gz.tbi,vcf.gz.csi}"
  - truth_vcf:
      type: "file"
      description: "Truth VCF file containing the ground truth baseline"
      pattern: "*.{vcf,vcf.gz}"
      ontologies:
      - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_3016"
  - truth_vcf_tbi:
      type: "file"
      description: "Index for the truth VCF file"
      pattern: "*.{vcf.gz.tbi,vcf.gz.csi}"
  - regions_bed:
      type: "file"
      description: "Regions BED file containing genomic regions to restrict the evaluation"
      pattern: "*.{bed}"
      ontologies:
      - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_3586"
- - meta2:
      type: "map"
      description: "Groovy Map containing reference fasta information"
  - fasta:
      type: "file"
      description: "Reference genome fasta file"
      pattern: "*.{fasta,fa,fasta.gz,fa.gz}"
      ontologies:
      - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_1929"
- - meta3:
      type: "map"
      description: "Groovy Map containing stratification TSV information"
  - stratification_tsv:
      type: "file"
      description: "Optional TSV file defining stratification regions for fine grained\
        \ benchmarking"
      pattern: "*.tsv"
      ontologies:
      - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_3475"
- - meta4:
      type: "map"
      description: "Groovy Map containing stratification BEDs information"
  - stratification_beds:
      type: "file"
      description: "Optional BED files corresponding to the regions defined in the\
        \ stratification TSV"
      pattern: "*.bed"
      ontologies:
      - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_3586"
output:
  summary:
  - - meta:
        type: "map"
        description: "Groovy Map containing sample information"
    - '*.summary.tsv':
        type: "file"
        description: "Global summary statistics of the variant comparison"
        pattern: "*.summary.tsv"
        ontologies:
        - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_3475"
  labelled_truth:
  - - meta:
        type: "map"
        description: "Groovy Map containing sample information"
    - '*.truth.vcf.gz':
        type: "file"
        description: "Truth VCF file annotated with evaluation results"
        pattern: "*.truth.vcf.gz"
        ontologies:
        - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_3016"
  labelled_query:
  - - meta:
        type: "map"
        description: "Groovy Map containing sample information"
    - '*.query.vcf.gz':
        type: "file"
        description: "Query VCF file annotated with evaluation results"
        pattern: "*.query.vcf.gz"
        ontologies:
        - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_3016"
  runinfo:
  - - meta:
        type: "map"
        description: "Groovy Map containing sample information"
    - '*.json':
        type: "file"
        description: "JSON file containing parameter settings used during the run"
        pattern: "*.json"
        ontologies:
        - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_3464"
  region_sequences:
  - - meta:
        type: "map"
        description: "Groovy Map containing sample information"
    - '*.region_sequences.tsv.gz':
        type: "file"
        description: "Sequence level output for specific evaluated regions"
        pattern: "*.region_sequences.tsv.gz"
        ontologies:
        - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_3475"
  region_summary:
  - - meta:
        type: "map"
        description: "Groovy Map containing sample information"
    - '*.region_summary.tsv.gz':
        type: "file"
        description: "Summary statistics broken down by individual genomic regions"
        pattern: "*.region_summary.tsv.gz"
        ontologies:
        - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_3475"
  versions_aardvark:
  - - ${task.process}:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the process"
    - aardvark:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the tool"
    - aardvark compare --version 2>&1 | sed 's/aardvark-bio-compare //; s/-conda//':
        type: "eval"
        description: "The expression to obtain the version of the tool"
topics:
  versions:
  - - ${task.process}:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the process"
    - aardvark:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the tool"
    - aardvark compare --version 2>&1 | sed 's/aardvark-bio-compare //; s/-conda//':
        type: "eval"
        description: "The expression to obtain the version of the tool"
authors:
- "@kubranarci"
maintainers:
- "@kubranarci"
containers:
  docker:
    linux/arm64:
      name: "community.wave.seqera.io/library/aardvark:0.10.5--00f3f25cea7c1408"
      build_id: "bd-00f3f25cea7c1408_1"
      scan_id: "sc-86490c728551a0d7_1"
    linux/amd64:
      name: "community.wave.seqera.io/library/aardvark:0.10.5--50402c072fe171c0"
      build_id: "bd-50402c072fe171c0_1"
      scan_id: "sc-080b7e623c56b7e6_1"
  singularity:
    linux/amd64:
      name: "oras://community.wave.seqera.io/library/aardvark:0.10.5--a5fcbec11f134d7d"
      build_id: "bd-a5fcbec11f134d7d_1"
      https: "https://community-cr-prod.seqera.io/docker/registry/v2/blobs/sha256/b1/b1594cf6a0ecac04adf5a88a88f1da08e5a8eb0f21cd6d42024b1b343cce0870/data"
    linux/arm64:
      name: "oras://community.wave.seqera.io/library/aardvark:0.10.5--2634d8b3310864e0"
      build_id: "bd-2634d8b3310864e0_1"
      https: "https://community-cr-prod.seqera.io/docker/registry/v2/blobs/sha256/ca/cab6d57df89751e6cbcdd91b101855b2537ad39c0b815aaff42019e0a2c7748c/data"
